performance.verdict: Six overdue SOW milestones and intake vacancy are the real money blockers, not the ads.

findings.text: CPL doubled to $227.30 (28d avg) with leads down 50% WoW and only 8 leads across the full 28-day window — spend efficiency has collapsed.

6 SOW milestones overdue: booking bot (Jul 31), intake owner (Aug 31), Review Boost (Aug 31), financing page (Aug 31), Homer Glen branch (Aug 31), LSA heating toggle (Sep 1) — all unresolved as of Sep 27.
3-day signal (Sep 24–26): 0 leads, spend $104.57, GBP actions = 0 for 3 consecutive days — top-of-funnel has gone effectively dark across all channels.

GBP actions collapsed to 0 for Sep 24–26 after averaging ~6/day Sep 11–15; flagged gbp_low_call_rate (1.19%) on Quality HVAC by Fibid despite 253 impressions over 26 days — profile is not converting searchers to callers.

GHL shows 1,207 opportunities created vs only 52 won (4.3% win rate) with 0 appointments logged — intake leak likely worsened by the vacant dispatch seat (Vivian left 7/7), meaning ads-driven leads are not being worked.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner and GHL login immediately; the vacant dispatch seat (since Jul 7) is letting paid leads die unworked.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian left on July 7 and the intake seat has not been confirmed replaced per the Aug 31 SOW milestone. With 1,207 GHL opportunities created but only 52 won (4.3%) and 0 appointments logged, leads are arriving but not being worked. Assign a named intake owner with verified GHL access and after-hours coverage. Success check: intake owner confirmed in writing and at least one GHL appointment logged by Oct 1.

suggestions.text: Resolve all 6 overdue SOW milestones — LSA heating toggle (Sep 1 overdue) is the highest-impact quick unlock for lead volume.
suggestions.monday_update: Six milestones are overdue ranging from Jul 31 to Sep 1, including the LSA heating toggle which was due Sep 1 and directly affects lead volume entering the fall heating season. The 3-day signal shows 0 leads Sep 24–26 with spend at $104.57, making the LSA re-enable the most immediately actionable item. Work through each milestone in date order: LSA toggle, then intake owner, Review Boost, financing page, Homer Glen branch, and booking bot battle-test. Success check: all 6 items marked complete in the SOW sheet by Oct 4.
